text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan Sistem

Insurans Pekerjaan (Perbekalan) 2020.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2020

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi satu ratus lapan puluh satu juta

lapan ratus dua puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM181,824,000)

daripada Kumpulan Wang Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi perbelanjaan untuk

pentadbiran Sistem Insurans Pekerjaan bagi tahun 2020 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan

bagi maksud yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 69,992,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 32,178,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain 50,000

Perbelanjaan lain 26,393,000

Harta tanah, loji dan kelengkapan 53,211,000

Jumlah 181,824,000

Dibuat 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/28/3; PN(PU)747/II]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Menteri Sumber Manusia

 EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM ACT 2017

 EMPLOYMENT INSURANCE SYSTEM (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 48(1) of the

Employment Insurance System Act 2017 [Act 800], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Employment Insurance System (Supply)

Regulations 2020.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2020

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding one hundred and eighty-one million

eight hundred and twenty-four thousand ringgit (RM181,824,000) from the

Employment Insurance System Fund for the expenditure on administration of the

Employment Insurance System for the year 2020 is hereby authorized for the purposes

specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purposes Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 69,992,000

Supplies and services 32,178,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments 50,000

Other expenditures 26,393,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 53,211,000

Total 181,824,000

Made 1 September 2020

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/28/3; PN(PU)747/II]

DATUK SERI SARAVANAN A/L MURUGAN

Minister of Human Resources
